name: A paused count is part of the reps performed, on both clients
why: The web app used to read `reps + pausedReps` as the reps of a set, so the same stored row meant six reps on iOS and eight on the web — one of them a rep nobody did. These four sets are the shapes the account actually holds, including the two rows in the real history that carry both numbers (120 kg × 6 with 2 paused, 60 kg × 9 with 1). Both clients must read them the same way: the reps are the reps, and the paused count says how many of them carried the pause.
